content.what_it_is: MATLAB vessel-morphology six-panel plotter. It derives a mirrored 2n-1 grid from dep_00000 (L2-L14), pairs files 40/80/120 with hand-written times 80/160/240 s (L18-L24), creates six tight axes (L27-L31), then loads/masks/mirrors eta and C for each frame and plots paired eta and log10 converted concentration panels (L33-L88). The only print command is commented at L89.
entities: nfile frame indices and min time strings @L18,L20
unresolved: Wet cells with CH=0 pass the mask at L41 but become -Inf in `log10(CH*2680*1000.0)` at L69; negative/sentinel concentrations produce non-real/NaN values. No positivity floor or invalid-value mask supports the finite [0,2.999] color range.

Displayed times are stored separately in `min` (L20,L58) instead of derived from nfile (L18); no cadence parameter or array-length check prevents silent mislabeling. The name `min` also shadows MATLAB's built-in minimum function.
The only print statement is commented at L89, so despite the file's batch-like construction it produces no image file unless run interactively and manually saved.
The absolute external-drive path is unchecked; field shapes and fixed plot axes are not validated against the loaded grid.
